subject.title: fix(heartbeat): preserve agent identity in global-scope heartbeat context

question: Should global-scope secondary-agent heartbeats use `MsgContext.AgentId` as the identity source while keeping the shared literal `global` session key?
rationale: The code-level change is narrow and matches the existing fallback contract, but it intentionally changes which agent owns workspace, provider, and auth context for existing global-scope secondary heartbeat runs.

options.title: Land The Identity Handoff
options.body: Accept the intended behavior change and merge after exact-head CI and ordinary maintainer review are acceptable.

options.title: Require Fuller Gateway Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Docker or gateway run showing the complete secondary-agent heartbeat path with model and delivery before merge.

options.title: Revise The Session Boundary
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want global-scope heartbeat store ownership or session semantics changed in a different layer.

recommendation.title: Land The Identity Handoff
recommendation.body: Accept the intended behavior change and merge after exact-head CI and ordinary maintainer review are acceptable.
